out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Walk-in cooler has a water leak dripping in the middle of the interior floor. Walk-in freezer interior fan unit has significant ice buildup.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Intake and exhaust air ducts are not being cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent contamination by dust, dirt, and other materials. Men’s and women’s restroom air vents need cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination.
